name: TC (DOCEtaxel / Cyclophosphamide)

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: The non-anthracycline taxane/alkylator TC cytotoxic backbone is not biomarker-restricted; it is a preferred preoperative/adjuvant regimen across HR-positive/HER2-negative and HR-negative/HER2-negative (TNBC) early breast cancer and is often chosen to avoid anthracycline cardiotoxicity. ER, PR, and HER2 are tested to guide added endocrine therapy (HR-positive) and HER2-directed therapy (HER2-positive), not to select the TC backbone. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer, Preoperative/Adjuvant Therapy Regimens (BINV-M 2 and 3 of 10; Preferred).

histology: invasive breast carcinoma (histology-agnostic; includes invasive ductal carcinoma (IDC), invasive lobular carcinoma (ILC), and triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC))

premedications.name: DOCEtaxel premedication
premedications.notes: corticosteroid premedication per docetaxel labeling to reduce fluid retention and hypersensitivity; give before docetaxel. Confirm exact schedule against institutional order set.

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: select antiemetic prophylaxis per the NCCN emetic-risk framework (Appendix D). The exact per-regimen tier is designated in the NCCN Antiemesis guideline / order template (not established in the provided sources).

supportiveCare: G-CSF / myeloid growth factor support: all cycles are given with myeloid growth factor support per Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M dosing footnote n.
Antiemetics: DOCEtaxel plus cyclophosphamide; prophylaxis per NCCN emetic-risk framework (Appendix D). Specific tier per NCCN Antiemesis order template.
Peripheral neuropathy: monitor (DOCEtaxel); consider limb cooling per BINV-M 1 of 10.
monitoring: liver and renal function before each cycle

doseModificationRules.text: Review required. Protocol-specific delay/reduce criteria may apply; physician decides.

drugs.name: DOCEtaxel
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 5 of 10. DOCEtaxel 75 mg/m2 IV day 1, cycled every 21 days for 4 to 6 cycles, with myeloid growth factor support (footnote n). ISMP tall-man.

provenance.locator: BINV-M 5 of 10, TC (DOCEtaxel/Cyclophosphamide) (dosing), references 2 (US Oncology 9735) and 3 (WSG PlanB)

drugs.name: Cyclophosphamide
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 5 of 10. Cyclophosphamide 600 mg/m2 IV day 1, cycled every 21 days for 4 to 6 cycles, with myeloid growth factor support (footnote n).
